schemaNote: accessibilityCost is a multiplier on distance. Weight = distance * accessibilityCost. Treat >=999 as impassable for step-free routing. bssid is the MAC address of the nearest WiFi access point, for indoor positioning where GPS is unreliable; empty string means not recorded. For floors with sourceType "svg", x and y are in the SVG's own coordinate system (the numbers in its viewBox), so nodes can be drawn directly onto that SVG; imageWidth/imageHeight are the viewBox width/height and metresPerPixel is metres per SVG unit.
